aliases: Goswami and Rao Measure Theory for Analysis and Probability extraction
note: A new measure-theoretic mathematical-foundations extraction (distinct from the earlier Kallenberg/Shum/Cover-Thomas extractions) proposing Knowledge Space is an infinite-dimensional measurable space (X,A) while epistemic uncertainty induces probability measures on it, with the genuine probability space being over KnowledgeOS trajectories (Omega_K,A_K,P_K) with Omega_K=prod_{t>=0} X_t, not over Knowledge Space itself; introduces an epistemic information filtration F_t=sigma(info available up to t), Kolmogorov-consistency and Tulcea-theorem-motivated construction of the trajectory law, a warning that P(k)=0 does not mean k does not exist (infinite coin-toss analogy), an explicit non-identity Zero(K_t,I_t,EC) != P(A|F_t), five distinct convergence modes for epistemic stability, and an explicit list of what measure theory does NOT give KnowledgeOS (truth, justification, meaning, governance, inquiry adequacy).

aliases: review of markdown(20260901-220954).md, the Bhagavad Gita / Lord-Zero lens synthesis
note: A structured critique (not itself a read of the source, which is a separate ~2701-line document not in this batch) of a prior Gita/Lord-Zero-lens synthesis document: endorses its Knower!=Reality!=IdealState!=Knowledge four-way separation, its dimension!=statement distinction, its Completeness!=Sufficiency!=Confidence!=Priority separation, its superseded!=false principle, and its four-boundary Zero taxonomy (Zero-1 known-dimension-unknown-value, Zero-2 unknown-dimension, Zero-3 known-dimensions-unknown-relationship, Zero-4 representation failure); but rejects the proposed Gap_t=S_t*-K_t set-subtraction as mathematically invalid (heterogeneous structured states cannot simply subtract) in favor of a typed difference operator Delta(K_t,I_t,Q_t,C_t), rejects canonizing Knowledge=Representation+Provenance+Context+Determination and Fact=Proposition+Observation+Context+Time+Provenance as artifact schemas rather than definitions, recommends the Knower/Observer Lens become an observer-indexed filtration parameter O=(Agent,Position,Method,Capability,Context,Time) rather than a kernel operator, corrects the document's lifecycle model (Observed->Interpreted->Determined->Used->Challenged->Revised->Superseded) from states-of-Knowledge-itself to epistemic-statuses-of-an-artifact, and flags a notation collision (R_t, Q_t, P_t each used inconsistently) recommending a notation freeze.

A formal 22-definition consolidation building directly on the same-day Goswami-Rao measure-theory extraction: defines Knowledge Space as a measurable space KS=(X,A) built from an index set J of admissible epistemic observables Y_j (never a probability space by default), with a representation map Gamma:K -> A giving a compatibility region for each Knowledge State, an information filtration F_t, a probabilistic assessment Pi_t=L(Z|F_t) kept distinct from K_t, an Ideal State I_t=I(Q_t,C_t,S_t,EC_t), a typed (not scalar-subtraction) Knowledge Gap Delta_t=D(K_t,I_t;Q_t,C_t,EC_t), Zero as an indicator predicate 1[K_t models EC_t], a (possibly probabilistic) transition T_t, a trajectory space Omega_K=prod X_t with process probability space (Omega_K,A_K,P_K), observer-specific filtrations F_t^S, a semantic-equivalence relation r1=_sem r2 via matching observable behaviour B_r, and an explicit four-way non-collapse syntactic-equality != representation-equality != semantic-equivalence != almost-sure-equality. Concludes the 13-vs-8 kernel-reduction instability arose from attempting kernel minimality before X, A, =_sem, K, D and T were fixed, and reframes the next research question from 'what is Knowledge Space' to 'what is the minimal admissible family of epistemic observables {Y_j} that generates (X,A)'. Possibly the same architecture as this batch's goswami-rao-measure-theoretic-knowledge-space-architecture (produced the same day, explicitly building on it), possibly a distinct, more formalized successor artifact -- not resolved within this batch.

aliases: KnowledgeOS Theory -- Integrated Formal Theory v1.0
note: A same-day (2026-09-02) 62-section consolidation act explicitly declaring a first 'complete KnowledgeOS theory at the theory/architecture level', built by integrating the day's relational-structure-core-regime-model restatement, the measure-theory Knowledge Space work, and the kernel-reduction experiment's 13-vs-8 finding into one document. New content beyond straightforward restatement of those three threads: a five-node control loop graph K_t->I_t->Delta_t->Inquiry->Lord->Proposal->Sarathi->Decision->Authorization->Action->K_{t+1} unifying the Lord/Sarathi decision material with the epistemic gap apparatus; a formal regime tuple R=(D_R,S_R,M_R,Inf_R,Meas_R,A_R) adding an explicit declared-assumptions component; an anti-corruption principle forbidding a regime from silently redefining a core term (Knowledge=PosteriorProbability, Knowledge=PointInMetricSpace, Knowledge=Integral all explicitly forbidden); a named personified-principle table (Shani=invariant-preservation-across-transitions, Ganesha=Ubiquitous-Language discipline, Krishna=purpose constraint, Leonardo=mandatory-assumption-declaration, Roberts=measurement-legitimacy chain, Rudin=rigorous-machinery-only-when-warranted, Aggoun&Elliott=stochastic-filtering-regime, Williamson/Pritchard=anti-reduction epistemological guardrail); a five-layer architecture (Semantic Domain / Core Epistemic Structure / Representation-Projection / Mathematical Regimes / Evaluation-Decision); a distinction between the five architecture layers and the separate seven-level research-order methodology; a named 'Semantic Preservation Principle' fundamental-theorem candidate; a six-object 'deepest structure' compression (C,K_t,I_t,Delta_t,Theta,R); a one-equation formal backbone; a settled-vs-open ledger (7 open questions numbered 1-7); and an explicit announcement that the next document should be 'KnowledgeOS Theory v1.0 -- Definitions, Axioms, Invariants, Formal Model and Proof Obligations' with a DEFINITION->AXIOM->THEOREM->PROPOSITION->EMPIRICAL RESULT->ARCHITECTURAL RULE->OPEN QUESTION separation -- directly anticipating this same batch's later 'definitions-axioms-theorems-corollaries' and 'formal-theory-of-epistemic-gaps' documents.

aliases: KnowledgeOS Theory v1.0 -- Formal Definitions, Axioms, Theorems, Corollaries and Architectural Consequences

aliases: I.J. Good, Probability and the Weighing of Evidence (1950), extraction
note: A new external-source extraction (I.J. Good's 1950 book) introducing a hypothesis-relative Weight-of-Evidence apparatus as a missing evidence-assessment layer between Evidence and Determination: the evidential factor F(E;H,Hbar)=O(H|E)/O(H)=P(E|H)/P(E|Hbar) (likelihood ratio), its log-additive weight W(E;H1,H2)=log F with evidence polarity (support/weakening/neutral), an explicit non-additivity warning (weights only add under independence, motivating an evidence-dependence relation Dep(Ei,Ej|H,C,M)), a likelihood-vs-probability precision distinction (Precision(E|H) does not imply Determination(H|E)), hypothesis-space scoping requirements (pairwise superiority != global determination; Reject(H1) does not imply Accept(H2)), a formal/rule/suggestion trichotomy for classifying theoretical claims, an 'honesty of approximation' provenance requirement, a relevance-selection operator candidate, a significance/estimation/determination/decision four-way non-collapse, an information-quantity-vs-hypothesis-relative-weight distinction (via Shannon entropy -log p vs weight of evidence), a proxy/summary-statistic non-identity principle, and a consolidated 18-item EW-01..EW-18 candidate invariant registry, closing with an explicit list of what NOT to import (Bayesianism as universal epistemology, numeric probability as universal uncertainty representation, log-odds as the universal measure, maximum likelihood as universal inference, entropy as knowledge, significance testing as determination, simplicity as a truth criterion, mandatory subjective priors, unevidenced independence assumptions, Good's own 1950 terminology as DDD language).

aliases: KnowledgeOS Theory v1.0 -- Formal Theory of Epistemic Gaps
note: A fully self-contained formal sub-theory of the Knowledge Gap, developed the same day as and explicitly building on this batch's v1.0 Definitions/Axioms/Theorems document (reusing its DEF-21/DEF-22/THM-4 Gap/Zero apparatus but developing it into its own DEF-G1/DEF-G2/THM-G1..G6 numbering): rejects Delta=I-K as mathematically too strong, defines the Gap as the set of unsatisfied epistemic requirements Delta_t={r in R_t : Sat(K_t,r)=0} with no arithmetic/vector-space assumption; derives Zero as the bottom element of the gap lattice (P(R_t),subseteq); introduces a ten-class gap taxonomy (Coverage/Value/Uncertainty/Evidence-Warrant/Contradiction/Model/Observability/Temporal-Staleness/Identity-Referential/Representation gaps); a positive-deficit/negative-conflict/epistemic-insufficiency three-way reduction; a three-level Semantic->Typed->Numerical gap hierarchy with a derived weighted gap functional G(K_t,EC_t) and the Zero-equivalence theorem G=0 iff Delta_t=empty (THM-G3); a partial order K_{t+1} >=_EC K_t iff Delta_{t+1} subseteq Delta_t with a proven gap-reduction theorem (THM-G2); a contract-invariance theorem (THM-G4, gap comparison requires contract compatibility, preventing 'moving the goalposts'); the gap-increase-does-not-imply-knowledge-decrease result (an investigation can enlarge the known gap while improving epistemic honesty); a gap-composition/algebra structure (P(R),Sat,Type,union,subseteq); reformalized Lord/Sarathi roles as Gap->Proposal->Decision; a Gap Control theorem (THM-G5); a two-measure Progress vector (Adequacy, GapObservability, Warrant, UncertaintyReduction, ModelAdequacy); a Gap Decomposition theorem (THM-G6, non-exclusive overlapping gap classes); and a closing ten-item explicitly OPEN list. Possibly the same milestone object as knowledgeos-theory-v1-0-definitions-axioms-theorems (a companion/extension chapter of the same v1.0 specification), possibly a distinct standalone artifact -- not resolved within this batch.

aliases: CLAUDE CODE PROMPT -- KNOWLEDGEOS THEORY v1.1 SIMULATION EXPERIMENT
note: A full 35-section executable research protocol (explicitly modelled on the KR-2026-09-01 kernel-reduction protocol's discipline) mandating a controlled simulation of the full derived KnowledgeOS Theory v1.0/v1.1 epistemic lifecycle, to test whether ~26 named conceptual roles (Reality, Observation, Information, Evidence, Interpretation, Hypothesis, Hypothesis Space, Evidence Assessment, Epistemic Standards, Model, Determination, Knowledge Attribution, Epistemic State, K_t, Inquiry, Ideal State, Requirements, Gap, Zero, Proposal, Decision, Authorization, Action, History, Identity, Revision/Supersession) can coexist operationally without collapsing into each other. Specifies ten required synthetic-world scenario families (A simple determination through J unobservable property), a mandatory four-way Unknown taxonomy test, a full 21-step epistemic lifecycle trace requirement, an information-conservation (data-processing) test, a knowledge-attribution factivity test, a non-circular semantic-equivalence test, a representation-invariance test, a transition-vocabulary test (Acquire/Interpret/Assess/Determine/Attribute/Revise/Reject/Accept/Supersede), a reframed kernel-minimality test (capabilities first, operators only after), a Zero test over 8 named cases, an Ideal-State test, a decision-boundary test, a history/identity test, a causal/statistical confounding test, a provenance test, 18 named adversarial test cases, 20 named property-based tests (P1-P20), Monte Carlo requirements with mandatory vacuity auditing, a mandatory no-smuggling audit inspecting nine named operators for hidden capability leakage, an oracle-independence requirement, a formal type-check over 24 named types with notation-collision inspection, a circularity audit (five named candidate circular-definition pairs), a theory-consistency dependency graph, a first-class negative-results discipline, 17 named success criteria (S1-S17), an explicit success-does-not-mean-proof discipline, 12 required output artifacts (A-L, including a nine-class Theory Gap Register G1-G9), a seven-part final verdict format (with a four-choice, deliberately conservative Theory Status classification), an autonomous-execution rule, a reproducibility mandate, and a closing scientific principle that the goal is not to prove the theory correct but to discover exactly what survives, fails, and remains open.

The actual executed results of the KR-SIM-2026-09-02 simulation experiment mandated by this batch's own v1.1 simulation protocol (S2379): all 10 scenario families (A-J) execute the full epistemic lifecycle and 19 of 20 properties hold, but P11 (factivity) fails NECESSARILY -- a genuine negative structural theorem (not a bug) proving DEF-1 factivity (Knows(a,p,c,t)->True(p,c,t)) and the v1.1 attribution equation K=Gamma(E,Q,C,EC) are jointly unsatisfiable for any total Gamma that attributes anything, since Gamma is a function of E alone and E contains no truth (demonstrated by a bit-identical-epistemic-state witness across two worlds with different ground truth, and confirmed at a 0.1237 conditional failure rate over 10,000 randomized trials). Also finds Adequate and Zero are extensionally identical (both reduce to Delta_t=empty, so DEF-20 does no independent work of DEF-22), semantic equivalence remains circular, and Revision-without-retraction produces permanent underdetermination in any world that changes over time (the theory's single Revise operation cannot express the corpus's seven revision verbs). A 26-type formal type table finds 10 notation collisions (worst: P three-way Proposition/Probability/Preservation-vector; E dangerously conflates Evidence and the new v1.1 EpistemicState) but zero genuine type collisions. A no-smuggling audit finds oracle independence clean (World.truth unreadable by any agent transition, the load-bearing guarantee making the factivity result real rather than an artifact) but flags one instrumentation artifact (three scenarios construct observation tokens directly rather than through a channel) and two open unauditable questions (hypothesis-space narrowing, requirement-kind exhaustiveness).
